# CricketHub

> Real-time live cricket scores, ball-by-ball commentary, match schedules, ICC player rankings, comprehensive career statistics, and head-to-head player comparisons.

## Core Features & Sections

- [Live Cricket Scores](https://cricket-hub-0gc4.onrender.com/?tab=live): Real-time live scores, ball-by-ball commentary, batting partnerships, and miniscores for international and league cricket matches.
- [Upcoming Match Schedules](https://cricket-hub-0gc4.onrender.com/?tab=schedule): Timetable of bilateral tours, upcoming series, ICC tournaments, venues, and starting times.
- [Player Statistics & Profiles](https://cricket-hub-0gc4.onrender.com/?tab=players): Detailed career batting averages, strike rates, bowling figures, and personal records for over 1,190+ verified international cricket players.
- [Head-to-Head Player Comparison](https://cricket-hub-0gc4.onrender.com/?tab=compare): Side-by-side performance analytics, radar charts, and format-by-format breakdowns across Test, ODI, T20I, and IPL matches.

## API Documentation & Endpoints

- [Live Scores API](https://cricket-hub-0gc4.onrender.com/api/live): JSON feed of current live and completed matches.
- [Upcoming Schedules API](https://cricket-hub-0gc4.onrender.com/api/schedule): JSON list of upcoming cricket fixtures.
- [Player Profiles API](https://cricket-hub-0gc4.onrender.com/api/players/viratkohli): JSON career statistics and biographical data.
- [XML Sitemap](https://cricket-hub-0gc4.onrender.com/sitemap.xml): Machine-readable index of all site pages and player profiles.
- [Robots Directives](https://cricket-hub-0gc4.onrender.com/robots.txt): Search engine crawler directives.

## Optional & Extended Details

- [Full Documentation](https://cricket-hub-0gc4.onrender.com/llms-full.txt): Extended platform architecture and statistical model.
